result.instructions: Tools for ReturnGO, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which return requests are waiting for approval?"; "Show me the RMAs created this week and their status."; "Approve RMA 1234 and add a note that the item was checked.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ReturnGO data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run returngo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run returngo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run returngo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. returngo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: returngo_list_rmas
tools.title: List RMAs
tools.description: List and search return requests (RMAs) for the store. Filter by status, creation or update time, order names, tracking numbers or customer ids. Use the returned cursor to page. ReturnGO API: GET /rmas.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response, to get the next page.

sort_by.description: Sort columns: rma_created_at or rma_updated_at, prefix - for descending or + for ascending, comma separated. E.g. -rma_created_at.

rma_created_at.description: Filter on the creation time: operator:ISO datetime. Operators: lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, neq. E.g. gte:2026-01-01T00:00:00.

rma_updated_at.description: Filter on the last update time: operator:ISO datetime. Operators: lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, neq. E.g. gte:2026-01-01T00:00:00.

status.description: Comma-separated RMA statuses: Pending, Approved, Received, Validated, Done, Rejected, Canceled.

tools.name: returngo_get_rma
tools.title: Get an RMA
tools.description: Get one RMA with its items, status, timeline, shipments and transactions. Set includeMedia to include customer-uploaded photos. ReturnGO API: GET /rma/{rmaId}.

includeMedia.description: Include customer media (photos) in the response.

tools.name: returngo_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List and search refunds, payment authorizations, captures and invoice payments linked to returns. Filter by status, type, processor, RMA or order ids. ReturnGO API: GET /transactions.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous response, to get the next page.

created_at.description: Filter on the creation time: operator:ISO datetime. Operators: lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, neq. E.g. gte:2026-01-01T00:00:00.

updated_at.description: Filter on the last update time: operator:ISO datetime. Operators: lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, neq. E.g. gte:2026-01-01T00:00:00.

tools.name: returngo_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks registered for the store, with their event subscriptions and target URLs. ReturnGO API: GET /webhooks.

tools.name: returngo_track_shipment
tools.title: Track a shipment
tools.description: Get the current tracking status of a return shipment after it was created. Give the shipment id, creation date, order id, destination zip and tracking number. ReturnGO API: POST /shipment-tracker.

shipmentCreationDate.description: When the shipment was created, e.g. 2026-11-01.

lineItems.description: Line item ids of the order, as used on the e-commerce platform.

tools.name: returngo_set_shipment
tools.title: Set shipment details
tools.description: Update the carrier, tracking number, tracking URL, label URL and status of one shipment. All five fields are sent, so pass the current values for the ones you do not change. ReturnGO API: PUT /shipment/{shipmentId}.

tools.name: returngo_add_rma_comment
tools.title: Add an RMA comment
tools.description: Add a merchant comment to an RMA's timeline. The note is HTML text. Adds a new comment each call. ReturnGO API: POST /rma/{rmaId}/comment.

htmlText.description:
The comment text, as HTML code (e.g.

Item checked.

).

tools.name: returngo_set_rma_status
tools.title: Set an RMA status
tools.description: Move an RMA to a new status. ReturnGO runs every side effect of that transition, as set by the return policy (for example customer emails or refunds). Give reject_reason for Rejected and cancel_reason for Canceled. ReturnGO API: PUT /rma/{rmaId}/status.

reject_reason.description: Reason for rejecting the RMA (status Rejected).

cancel_reason.description: Reason for cancelling the RMA (status Canceled).

tools.name: returngo_update_transaction
tools.title: Update a transaction
tools.description: Set the status of a transaction, or link it to an external reference (for example a refund processed on your platform). Allowed transitions: Requested to Success or Failed, Failed to Success. ReturnGO API: PUT /transaction/{transactionId}.

externalReferenceId.description: Id of the matching record on your platform.
